(“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today announced that it has signed a definitive note purchase agreement providing for a private placement of $250 million senior unsecured notes of which $150 million are designated as 5.07% Series A senior notes due August 11, 2029, and $100 million are designated as 5.20% Series B senior notes due August 11, 2032 (collectively, the “Notes”). Estimated terms of this private placement transaction were included in the first quarter guidance provided by the Company.
